== Biography ==
'''Alexander Glasgow''' was born about 1816 in County Antrim, Ireland. The 1851
census gave his birthplace as Runflea, County Antrim, and his age as thirty-
five.<ref name="Glenleslie1851">[https://nationalarchives.ie/collections/search-the-census/census-record/#census_year=1851&surname__icontains=Glasgow&county=Antrim&limit=30&id=32216 1851 Census of Ireland], Glenleslie house 35, Dunaghy, County Antrim.</ref>

Alexander married [[Martin-93219|Mary Anne Martin]] on 6 April 1847 at Clogh.
The original register describes him as a full-age bachelor and labourer living
at Glenleslie. His father was '''John Glasgow, labourer'''. Mary Anne was a
full-age spinster and daughter of John Martin, labourer. Peter Richmond and John
Montgomery witnessed the marriage.<ref name="Marriage1847">[https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/marriage_returns/marriages_1847/09322/5375567.pdf General Register Office of Ireland, civil marriage register], Alexander Glasgow and Mary Anne Martin, 6 April 1847, Clogh, entry 31; derivative [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QGVD-P9CS FamilySearch index entry].</ref>

In 1851 Alexander was an agricultural labourer at Glenleslie. Mary Anne, aged twenty-seven and born in County Armagh, worked as a linen weaver. Their son [[Glasgow-2826|John Glasgow]] was two years old and born in County Antrim.<ref name="Glenleslie1851" />

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-4056]] is assessed at 99% (proved). Alexander’s original 6 April 1847 marriage names his father John, a labourer. John-4056 is the record-defined father represented by that entry, with a compatible birth-before-1798 estimate.

Confident for the expressly named father, without claiming an otherwise unidentified earlier John’s ancestry.

Next useful test: Use John’s occupation and Alexander’s locality to research the next generation.

Source basis already held: [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/marriage_returns/marriages_1847/09322/5375567.pdf General Register Office of Ireland, civil marriage register, entry 31, marriage of Alexander Glasgow and Mary Anne Martin, 6 April 1847, Clogh, Ballymena registration district; General Register Office of Ireland, civil marriage image (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/marriage_returns/marriages_1847/09322/5375567.pdf).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



=== Death ===

No death or burial record has been found. The before-1917 death date is only an upper bound based on the estimated 1816 birth and is not a recorded date.

=== Father ===

Alexander's marriage proves that his father was [[Glasgow-4056|John Glasgow]], a labourer. The record-only profile for the older John is attached as Alexander's confident father. No inspected record gives John's age, wife or residence.

[[Glasgow-867|John Glasgow of Lisnagaver]] was formerly attached, but his family gravestone places his birth about 1816 or 1817, while the conflicting 1851 return places it about 1801. Neither date permits him to be Alexander's father, and he was a farmer rather than the labourer named in the marriage.<ref name="RasharkinStone">[https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/RasharkinP/graveyard.html Pauline O'Keeffe and Helen Evans, ''Rasharkin Second Presbyterian Church headstones''], transcription made August 2004, Glasgo memorial erected by James Garvin Glasgo.</ref>

[[Glasgow-1022|John Glasgow of Glenleslie]] is old enough to be the father named
in 1847, but he was recorded as a farmer rather than a labourer and no record
calls Alexander his son. He remains a possible local candidate rather than an
identified parent.

Earlier notes compared Alexander with [[Glasgow-2710|Alexander Pitcairn Glasgow]], a Scottish child baptised in 1811, [[Glasgow-951|Alexander Glasgow of Lisnagaver]], and [[Glasgow-2824|another Alexander Glasgow born about 1815]]. The original 1847 marriage and the Glenleslie household define this Alexander as an adult labourer with wife Mary Anne Martin and son John; no inspected record establishes any of those same-name profiles as this man.

The [https://www.myheritage.com/research/collection-20882/ireland-marriages-1845-1958 MyHeritage Ireland marriage index] and its [https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-20882-2493853/alexander-glasgow-in-ireland-marriages Alexander Glasgow entry] are retained as derivative finding aids. The original register, rather than the index's list of possible spouses, identifies Mary Anne Martin as Alexander's wife.
